reviews.title: Great, but expensive
reviews.comment: The Noctua NF-A14x25r G2 PWM Sx2-PP is a premium push-pull fan set for CPU coolers. Used to replace existing fans on Noctua NH-U14S. Delivers almost inaudible noise levels, even at full speed. Installation is easy with included accessories. Performs extremely well on Intel i5-13600K, providing efficient cooling with minimal acoustics.
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.title: Top notch dual 140mm (Round Frame) fans!
reviews.comment:
-Very quiet and superb quality
-Noise level is excellent
-Excellent air performance
-comes with multiple adapters such as Y-cable, Extension cable, Quiet Noise adapter, rubber dampeners, etc.
Cons:
-It does not come with fan clips which you may need to contact Noctua to send you fan clips replacement at free of charge
-Ideal for CPU fan heatsink to attach with Noctua NH-D15 G2 HBC (Intel LGA 1851)/Noctua NH-D15 G2 LBC (AMD AM4/AM5 socket)
Conclusion:
Noctua has delivered an outstanding air performance, incredibly quiet, and very easy to install for your CPU Air Heatsink which is deal for Noctua NH-D15 G2 HBC (Intel LGA 1851)/Noctua NH-D15 G2 LBC (AMD AM4/AM5 socket). Yes, my dual 140mm fans have failed somehow since my motherboard wasn't able to recognize it via BIOS which I have to order another dual 140mm fans as a replacement. Still, it's worth the value in my opinion.

reviews.title: top of the line cooling fans, typical noctua quiet
reviews.comment:
amazing fans, I mounted these to a D15 cooler in place of the stock fans and instead of the 2-3C claimed I got like 10C cooler! not sure what was going on there. Only thing I can think of is I wasnt mounting the original fans well enough (maybe)
typical noctua quiet, havent tested the durability yet but i'm sure its good
ive never had a noctua fan die on me, i had my D14 cooler for over 10 years and the fans were fine
i only upgraded to a D15 cuz I felt like I was milking the company with their free backplate upgrade program
I love this company and will continue to buy from them any time I need fans! Dont ever change guys!
reviews.author: Chris LaRosa

reviews.title: 120mm Mounting Pattern on ‘r’ designated variation
reviews.comment:
I’ve been waiting on the release of the 140mm x25 fan, this version features a 120mm mounting pattern, these variations are designated with an ‘r’, and have a round frame style, and are purpose designed as 140mm fans with 120mm screw placement. The traditional square frame version (non-r), which will have a 140mm mounting pattern, has not been released at the time of this review. Scheduled for September 2024.
That said, I really wanted to mount these fans on a 280mm radiator. Fortunately, Noctua makes a mounting adapter that, with a little modification (a rough trim with aviation snips), can be cut down to the corner pieces, providing the perfect fit for 140mm mounting points. I’m sure a neater job could have been accomplished with a rotary tool, or even 3D Printing. But for ~$13 adapters, they were cheap enough to just modify.
I’ve attached a photo showing the NF-A14x25r on a 280mm radiator, alongside another photo with the 120mm Square brethren, the NF-A12x25 for comparison Side-by-side. And the final put together radiator with semi-DIY adapters.
